name: Hesard Rook
role: Watch captain of the river wall, relieved and confined
appearance: A Redcollar captain's blackened half-plate, now hung on a peg in a guarded room.
voice: Smooth and quick to deny; goes quiet when cornered.
backstory: One of Halda's six captains, Rook commanded the river wall. A canary trap and his orderly Fenia's testimony exposed him as the Choir's informer in the Watch; Halda relieved him and confined him to quarters on day 9. On day 11 he refused the inquiry but asked to see the Lord-Marshal alone.
fears: The rope; being disowned by the only family he has left.
secrets: He fed the Choir news of the forge and of Chadickith's movements.
Lorard is his cousin, Pellot Rook's son, not the king's.
dm_only: He didn't know the Choir meant to burn the ward or the forge; the flame-silver sickened him.
Marda's record of his confession reaches Halda on day 14.
